reason: The text portrays the Israelites as a collective group with specific instructions and actions that affect an entire nation, not just individuals or a family. For example, 'וּלְכֹ֣ל׀ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֹ֤א יֶֽחֱרַץ־ כֶּ֙לֶב֙ לְשֹׁנ֔וֹ לְמֵאִ֖ישׁ וְעַד־ בְּהֵמָ֑ה' (And not a dog shall snarl at any of the Israelites, no, not at people or at animals) indicates a national identity rather than a familial one.
